rules.description: At least three decoded DNS query frames to resolver UDP/5300.
At least three decoded DNS response frames from resolver UDP/5300.
At least one decoded DNS query to upstream UDP/53.
Upstream DNS query-frame count is within the declared bound; correlate repeated names and TTL to establish caching.
A decoded NXDOMAIN response is present; negative caching is not established by this check.

manual_checks: R1 R2: Use decoded dns.qry.name and answers; DNS wire names contain length octets.
R1 R2 R3 R4: Match query names/types and transaction IDs. Demonstrate that the repeated response is a cache hit within TTL, with no corresponding upstream query.
R1 R2 R5: Assert NXDOMAIN. Repeating and caching this failure is optional unless selected in E1.
